"''Um, our hyperdrive's been hit. Going to take time to get it back up. You're go— have to jump without us.|Torra Doza and the pilot|audio=UnidentifiedShuttlePilot-RebuildingTheResistance.flac|}} An individual served as a '''pilot''' for the [[Resistance]], and in [[34 ABY]], was the [[captain]] of [[Shuttle two (Resistance)|shuttle two]], one of three [[Resistance shuttle|shuttles]] carrying Resistance recruits off the [[First Order]] controlled [[planet]] [[Dantooine]]. When the [[shuttle]]s attempted to [[Mission to Dantooine (Resistance)|escape]] the planet while being escorted by [[Ace Squadron|Ace]] and [[Jade Squadron]]s, they were attacked by a [[Galek's TIE fighter squadron|squadron]] of [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE fighters]]. Shuttle two was shot, and the [[pilot]] reported that their [[hyperdrive]] was damaged. Shortly after, the pilot reported that their hyperdrive would soon be fixed, but their shuttle was then shot down, [[Death|killing]] those aboard. ==Biography== {{Quote|How's that hyperdrive looking, captain?''"
"''Still working on it. Should be ready soon.|Torra Doza and the pilot|audio=UnidentifiedShuttlePilot2-RebuildingTheResistance.flac|}} [[File:ShuttleTwo-RebuildingTheResistance.png|thumb|right|300px|The pilot flew Shuttle two (pictured).]] An individual was a [[pilot]] for the [[Resistance]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] with the [[First Order]]. In [[34 ABY]], the pilot served as the [[captain]] of a [[Resistance shuttle]] designated [[Shuttle two (Resistance)|shuttle two]], one of three [[shuttle]]s carrying Resistance recruits off the First Order controlled [[planet]] [[Dantooine]]. When the Resistance's [[Jade Squadron]] and their ally [[Ace Squadron]] arrived above Dantooine to [[Mission to Dantooine (Resistance)|escort]] the shuttles past the First Order's [[Blockade of Dantooine|blockade]], the pilot launched shuttle two alongside the other Resistance shuttles and approached their escort. Before the Resistance [[Starship|ships]] could reach escape altitude, a [[Galek's TIE fighter squadron|squadron]] of [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE fighters]] was dispatched to destroy the shuttles. The two sides engaged in combat, with shuttle two eventually being shot by a TIE fighter, hitting its [[hyperdrive]]. [[Ace]] pilot [[Torra Doza]] asked for the captain's status, and they responded it would take some [[time]] for their damaged hyperdrive to be repaired, then told the other ships they would need to leave without them, with part of their reply being cut off by static. Doza told the pilot they would buy them time for their hyperdrive to be repaired. Soon after, when Doza asked for an update on the shuttle's hyperdrive, the pilot responded it would soon be ready, with their reply again coming through spottily. [[First Order TIE fighter pilot]] [[Jace Rucklin]] then fired on the pilot's shuttle, damaging it further and sending it plummeting toward Dantooine's surface. As the other Resistance ships jumped to hyperspace, Ace pilot [[Kazuda Xiono]] watched shuttle two's descent and mourned the [[death]]s of those aboard. ==Skills and abilities== The pilot was capable of flying a shuttle. ==Equipment== The pilot captained an unarmed Resistance shuttle designated Shuttle two. ==Behind the scenes== The pilot appeared, albeit only through voice, in "[[Rebuilding the Resistance]]," the seventeenth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' animated television series, which aired on [[January 19]], [[2020]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} The pilot was voiced by [[Sam Witwer]], who also voiced [[Resistance pilot]] [[Hugh Sion]] in the same episode. ==Appearances== *{{Resistance|Rebuilding the Resistance}} {{1st}} {{Voice}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of unidentified shuttle pilot (Resistance)}} {{Reflist}} [[Category:Captains]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Pilots]] [[Category:Resistance members]]
